title: PA(19,8,6) R8 parent replay: split/rerun CNF records bound to exact (spec, placement list, indices) inputs
scope: Formula binding only, for the frozen selection: every split record with a rerun suffix (_r2, _r3, _exact; no other suffix existed at the snapshot), the ordinary record each rerun repeats, and a seeded stratified sample (seed 20261017) of ordinary f/batch records over all split families present at the snapshot (M1 A3 ms01 encode_full, M1 A3' ms09 encode_partq, M1 A3'' ms09 encode_partbatch, M2 m2part_drat ms01 encode_skel_b.build_partbatch). Each formula was rebuilt in memory with the declared encoder from pinned copies of the lane sources, from the parent-pinned spec bytes and from the parent-verified (R6) placement list, using the declared indices with M1 explicit-list and M2 [lo,hi] semantics, then hashed and compared with the recorded cnf_sha256/cnf_bytes; bytes were discarded. Structural checks (filename index vs record field, batch ranges, list bounds, declared encoder) ran on every split record of the snapshot.
not_claimed: No UNSAT acceptance or certification of any record (old drat-trim, retired lrat-check-only and lane-written checker records alike), no proof was read or re-checked, no solver ran, no claim about cover completeness, unsampled records, records written after the snapshot, or PA(19,8,6) existence/nonexistence. PA(19,8,6) remains undecided. checker_class and worker_claim fields are worker-recorded fields only.

verdict_rules.item PASS: record bytes equal the snapshot, identity/name/index/range/encoder checks true, spec and placement list bytes equal the parent pins, encoder did not mutate its inputs, generated cnf_sha256 and cnf_bytes equal the record (plus leave vector and rerun-pair checks where applicable)
verdict_rules.item FAIL: any of those checks false (exact list in mismatches)
verdict_rules.item PENDING: not evaluated, or input/encoder not bound/supported
verdict_rules.overall: FAIL if any item FAIL; REVIEW if the source/spec/list freeze broke after the pin or a snapshot record changed/vanished afterwards; PASS_WITH_PENDING if any PENDING or a mutation control not as expected; else PASS (binding of the selection only)

sample_manifest.algorithm: random.Random(20261017). Items in evaluation order: (1) every record with a filename suffix (_r2/_r3/_exact/any later suffix) at the snapshot, census; (2) the ordinary record each rerun repeats; (3) strata in order ['A3', "A3'", "A3''", 'M2']; per directory (sorted): the ordinary record with the lowest filename index, the one with the highest, and k seeded random interior records via rng.sample on the index-sorted interior (k: A3=1, A3'=2, A3''=1, M2=all, i.e. census); then per stratum the earliest and latest record by mtime; (4) 40 records by rng.sample from the remaining ordinary M1 records sorted by path. Selection reads only paths, filename indices, family/dir and mtimes of the snapshot; no CNF was generated before this manifest was written.

worker_manifests.note: worker-recorded hashes; used only as time-stamped cross-references

next_actions: Unsampled ordinary records stay formula-unbound beyond the structural checks; extend by a census or a fresh seeded sample if acceptance needs them.
UNSAT acceptance still needs a parent proof check per record route (drat-trim on regenerated CNF + stored/streamed proof); retired lrat-check-only (_r2) and lane-written checker records never count.
independence_and_limits: The replay re-executes the lane encoder code (pinned byte copies); it shows that each selected record's formula is exactly the declared encoder applied to the pinned spec, the parent-verified placement list and the declared indices. It does not re-derive the encoders' clause semantics (see the encoder audit) or their soundness.
Placement lists are bound through R6 (parent regeneration from pinned code); the A->B map through R4/R6 (compare-map a_to_b plus R6 explicit isomorphisms). Spec bytes through R0 pins and R6 spec_S.

encode_full2.py, stream_check5.py and the rerun runners were not in snapshot S; their live bytes were pinned here and compared with the worker's time-stamped manifests (worker-recorded, not parent-verified).
Records carry no encoder hash; the exact-version claim rests on byte-equal regenerated CNFs, plus encoder mtimes that precede the records (pins.json).
Unsampled ordinary records are bound only by structural checks; the sample bounds the rate of formula mismatches but does not exclude isolated ones.
